title: Hash 编码切换：listpack 与 hashtable（且关系阈值）
expected_output:
small hash  -> listpack
big-value   -> hashtable
many-entry  -> hashtable
code:
HASH_MAX_ENTRIES = 128
HASH_MAX_VALUE = 64

def hash_encoding(d):
    n = len(d)
    if n == 0:
        return "listpack"
    if n <= HASH_MAX_ENTRIES and all(len(str(v).encode()) <= HASH_MAX_VALUE for v in d.values()):
        return "listpack"
    return "hashtable"

small = {"name": "alice", "age": "30"}
big = {("f%d" % i): ("x" * 70) for i in range(5)}      # 单值 70B > 64
many = {("k%d" % i): ("y" * 10) for i in range(200)}  # 200 字段 > 128
print("small hash  ->", hash_encoding(small))
print("big-value   ->", hash_encoding(big))
print("many-entry  ->", hash_encoding(many))
